title: Tuesday Reality Check: Are You Solving REAL Problems?
content:

title: Tuesday Reality Check: Are You Solving Problems or Building Features?
content:
There's a difference.

Features are what you THINK users want.
Solutions are what users ACTUALLY need.

You can have 100 features and solve zero problems.

Before you build your next feature, ask:

1. What problem does this solve?
2. How do you KNOW it's a problem?
3. Will users pay for this solution?

If you can't answer all 3, STOP BUILDING.

What problem are you solving?

#ProductThinking #TuesdayTruth

title: Monday Night Mission: Who's Your Dream Customer?
content:
